correctness.rationale: For A(V*)=(K,V*,K) with lower-left multiplication, R=(0,V*,0) is square zero. Given any two-sided ideal I, nonzero first diagonal scalar forces e0 by e0 I e0 and hence all R by R e0; similarly for e1 and e1 R. If neither appears, I=0⊕W⊕0 for closed W⊂V*; one diagonal forces its full kernel-of-opposite-character ideal; both give the unit. Closed ideals containing K(X) correspond to those in the Calkin quotient. Liu–Shen Corollary 9.6 supplies E(X)/K(X)=R. Works for V=0 and real/complex scalars. Correct as a short direct algebraic consequence.
